:::{#def-newton-raphson}
#### Newton-Raphson algorithm

The **Newton-Raphson algorithm** for solving the score equation
$\score(\th) = 0$
starts from an initial guess $\esttmp{\th}$
and repeats the update

$$
\begin{aligned}
\esttmp{\th}
&\leftarrow \esttmp{\th} - \inv{\hessf{\vx; \esttmp{\th}}} \scoref{\vx; \esttmp{\th}}\\
&= \esttmp{\th} + \inv{\oinff{\vx; \esttmp{\th}}} \scoref{\vx; \esttmp{\th}}
\end{aligned}
$$

until the estimate stops changing.
:::
